senses.gloss:
लय् लय् (= rt. रय्), cl. 1. A. लयते,
&c., to go.
लय लय, लयन, &c. See p. 868, cols. 2, 3.

लय, अस्, m. the act of clinging, adhering, stick-
ing, union, adherence; embracing, an embrace (=
श्लेष, सं-श्लेषण); the act of lying, cowering,
lurking, hiding; melting, fusion, solution, melting
away, dissolution, absorption, extinction, disappearing,
vanishing, disappearance, destruction, reduction (of
the Universe &c.) into its original state, death,
(लयं या or गम्, &c., to go to dissolution, melt
away, disappear, vanish; to be destroyed, perish);
rest, repose; place of rest, residence, house, dwelling;
mental inactivity, spiritual indifference, slackness of
mind; time (in music, regarded as of three kinds,
viz. द्रुत, ‘quick,’ मध्य, ‘mean or moderate,’
and विलम्बित, ‘slow’); a pause in music; a parti-
cular agricultural implement, (perhaps a sort of harrow
or hoe, Ved.); (अम्), n. the root of Andropogon
Muricatus; (अस्, आ, अम्), making the mind inactive
or indifferent.
—लय-काल, अस्, m. time of disso-
lution or destruction.
—लय-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone
to dissolution, dissolved, melted.
—लय-पुत्री, f.
‘daughter of (musical) time,’ a female dancer,
[]
actress.
—लयारम्भ (˚य-आर्˚) or लयालम्ब
(˚य-आल्˚), अस्, m. ‘moving according to time,’ a
dancer, actor.
—लयार्क (˚य-अर्˚), अस्, m. the sun
at the dissolution of the world.

लायम् लायम्, a word of uncertain mean-
ing in Ṛg-veda X. 42, 1, (perhaps an indec. part.
fr. rt. 1. ली), having bent down, bending; (according
to Sāy.) = संश्लेषणम् = हृदय-वेधिनं
शरम्.

लयन, अम्, n. the act of clinging, adhering,
lying, &c.; rest, repose; a place of rest, house.
